https://www.theguardian.com/australia-ne.text: One Nation MP Barnaby Joyce has been unable to confirm how his party’s sweeping new immigration policy would impact the budget or jobs while declaring they would “deal with it no matter the cost”. The former deputy leader appeared on the ABC’s second National Forum on Monday evening, which focused on immigration and multiculturalism. He faced backlash from panelists, with journalist and political commentator, George Megalogenis, claiming One Nation’s plan to cut migration in net terms over three years had never happened in Australian public policy and would “tank the economy” on the scale of the “depression of the 1890s”. Joyce said “the issue of what it’s going to cost … is contentious” and rejected questioning over why One Nation didn’t consult the parliamentary budget office. “The Australian people are sort of tired of the fact that you have to go to an economist to come up with policy to help us all better understand what it costs to us,” he claimed, adding it “has to be dealt with
